#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int required = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < required) size <<= 1;
    
    vector<double> ar(size, 0.0), ai(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        ar[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
        ai[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    
    // FFT
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int bit = size >> 1;
        while (j & bit) {
            j ^= bit;
            bit >>= 1;
        }
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(ar[i], ar[j]);
            swap(ai[i], ai[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= size; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cosTable(half), sinTable(half);
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (1);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            cosTable[i] = cos(i * angle);
            sinTable[i] = sin(i * angle);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i += len) {
            for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                double ur = ar[i + k];
                double ui = ai[i + k];
                double vr = ar[i + k + half] * cosTable[k] - ai[i + k + half] * sinTable[k];
                double vi = ar[i + k + half] * sinTable[k] + ai[i + k + half] * cosTable[k];
                
                ar[i + k] = ur + vr;
                ai[i + k] = ui + vi;
                ar[i + k + half] = ur - vr;
                ai[i + k + half] = ui - vi;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> br(size, 0.0), bi(size, 0.0);
    if (a == b) {
        br = ar;
        bi = ai;
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
            long long val = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            br[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
            bi[i] = val >> 15;
        }
        
        // FFT for b
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int bit = size >> 1;
            while (j & bit) {
                j ^= bit;
                bit >>= 1;
            }
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                swap(br[i], br[j]);
                swap(bi[i], bi[j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 2; len <= size; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            vector<double> cosTable(half), sinTable(half);
            double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (1);
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                cosTable[i] = cos(i * angle);
                sinTable[i] = sin(i * angle);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i += len) {
                for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                    double ur = br[i + k];
                    double ui = bi[i + k];
                    double vr = br[i + k + half] * cosTable[k] - bi[i + k + half] * sinTable[k];
                    double vi = br[i + k + half] * sinTable[k] + bi[i + k + half] * cosTable[k];
                    
                    br[i + k] = ur + vr;
                    bi[i + k] = ui + vi;
                    br[i + k + half] = ur - vr;
                    bi[i + k + half] = ui - vi;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> cr(size, 0.0), ci(size, 0.0);
    double scale = 0.25 / size;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        
        double A1r = ar[i] + ar[j];
        double A1i = ai[i] - ai[j];
        double A2r = ai[i] + ai[j];
        double A2i = ar[j] - ar[i];
        
        double B1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * scale;
        double B1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * scale;
        double B2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * scale;
        double B2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * scale;
        
        cr[i] = A1r * B1r - A1i * B1i - A2r * B2i - A2i * B2r;
        ci[i] = A1r * B1i + A1i * B1r + A2r * B2r - A2i * B2i;
    }
    
    // Inverse FFT
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int bit = size >> 1;
        while (j & bit) {
            j ^= bit;
            bit >>= 1;
        }
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(cr[i], cr[j]);
            swap(ci[i], ci[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= size; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cosTable(half), sinTable(half);
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (-1);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            cosTable[i] = cos(i * angle);
            sinTable[i] = sin(i * angle);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i += len) {
            for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                double ur = cr[i + k];
                double ui = ci[i + k];
                double vr = cr[i + k + half] * cosTable[k] - ci[i + k + half] * sinTable[k];
                double vi = cr[i + k + half] * sinTable[k] + ci[i + k + half] * cosTable[k];
                
                cr[i + k] = ur + vr;
                ci[i + k] = ui + vi;
                cr[i + k + half] = ur - vr;
                ci[i + k + half] = ui - vi;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        cr[i] /= size;
        ci[i] /= size;
    }
    
    vector<int> result(required);
    for (int i = 0; i < required; i++) {
        long long realPart = llround(cr[i]);
        long long imagPart = llround(ci[i]);
        result[i] = (int)((realPart + ((imagPart % mod) << 15)) % mod);
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    vector<int> poly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx;
        cin >> idx;
        poly[idx] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> res = {1};
    int exponent = n / 2;
    
    while (true) {
        if (exponent & 1) {
            res = multiply(res, poly, MOD);
        }
        exponent >>= 1;
        if (exponent == 0) break;
        poly = multiply(poly, poly, MOD);
    }
    
    long long total = 0;
    for (int val : res) {
        total = (total + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    
    cout << total << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
